shortDescription: Read a YAML file from the remote host and return the parsed content

options.name: encoding
options.description: Encoding used to decode the file content.

options.name: multiple_documents
options.description: When C(true), parse the file as a multi-document YAML stream and return a list of documents in the C(yaml) key. When C(false) (the default), the file is parsed as a single document.

options.name: src
options.description: Path to the YAML file on the remote host.
